long_biography.plain_text:
An industry fair aimed mainly at German trade buyers gave Sven Hurum the opening for VENUS. He developed a larger international event with support from established suppliers. Berlin offered an existing business base and a city name recognisable beyond Germany, while the fair welcomed both professional buyers and consumers.

Hurum and his team learned exhibition management while preparing the first show, handling registrations, promotional mailings, hall layouts and an awards programme. As the fair developed, he sought to bring its different commercial communities together. For the tenth edition, a dedicated web area gave internet businesses exhibition space alongside suppliers of physical products.
